fills.researcher_notes: COMPANY-LEVEL FINDING, applied identically across all three rows in this brief (P0929, P0954, P2216): GAIL (India) Ltd is the operator, not just the owner, of its own wholly-owned (100%) common-carrier gas transmission lines -- it does not route operation through a separate SPV the way it does for JV pipelines. Evidence for THIS row (JHBDPL): Oil & Gas Journal, reporting on this exact pipeline, refers throughout to 'its Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro-Dhamra natural gas pipeline network' (possessive 'its' = GAIL's own operated network, not merely a project it built for a third party) and states 96.6% is already 'under commercial operations' as part of that network -- consistent with GAIL running the line itself rather than handing operation to another entity. I could not find a sentence on this specific JHBDPL page that uses the literal word 'operator' (checked ogj.com, nsenergybusiness.com, offshore-technology.com's JHBDPL-phase-two page, cgdindia.net -- all use 'developed by' / 'implemented by' / 'executed by' GAIL, not 'operated by'). The literal word IS used for GAIL on the two sibling PNGRB-Sr.7-family authorisations in this brief (see P0954 and P2216, both offshore-technology.com: 'will be operated by GAIL (India)'), and this row's authorisation (PNGRB register Sr. No. 7, already staged separately at batches/india-gas/staging/register-crosswalk/staged_resolutions.json) names GAIL -- not an SPV -- as the sole authorisation holder, the same pattern as the other two. Given GAIL is 100% owner with no SPV interposed, is the authorisation holder of record, and is described everywhere as running (not merely having built) this exact network, GAIL (India) Ltd is the correct Operator fill. Note the PNGRB register is an OWNER source (authorisation holder), not independently an OPERATOR source per se -- it corroborates but does not by itself establish operator identity; the OGJ 'its ... network' framing is the operator-facing evidence for this row. tier=medium (one directly-on-point trade-press source using ownership-implying possessive language for this exact pipeline, plus company-pattern corroboration rather than a second row-specific 'operated by GAIL' sentence -- weaker than P0954/P2216's explicit wording, so held to medium rather than high).
